full_page.content:
Yesterday he wired from Seattle that our Brother Patrick is not well and just now (11 a.m.) a wire from Minneapolis from Msgr. says he hopes to see Pat by Friday a.m. in Seattle.
I sent Br. Patrick an air special yesterday after Owen's wire.
God bless you again - one and all. Keep well and always ready to re- stond to the one important summens.
Sincerely yours in Christ Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap.
